newsitem.title: UK: Brosnan says four James Bond films enough for him.
newsitem.headline: Brosnan says four James Bond films enough for him.

text.p: Pierce Brosnan would like to end his career as superspy James Bond after just four films.

Brosnan, who took over the role for "Goldeneye" and is contracted to make another three Bond pictures, told the Sun tabloid: "I'm still enjoying it but I'm 43 now. I don't want people to watch me getting old and see my waist get bigger and my hair thinner. That would be just horrible."
The Irish actor, who starts work soon on "Tomorrow Never Dies", said: "If the four Bonds I make are successful, then I'm sure the studio will put pressure on me to stay for another one.
"But even if they offered me 30 million pounds ($49 million), I don't think I would," said Brosnan, now filling the role that made Sean Connery and Roger Moore international stars.
"Then again -- 30 million pounds is a lot of money, isn't it?" he quipped.
